public.rule: No authentication; response body is intentionally public. No object-existence concern.

owner.rule: Object is owned by the acting Student. A request for another user's (or another tenant's) object returns an indistinguishable 404 — existence is never confirmed to a non-owner. Composed staff readers are scoped before lookup and also 404-masked out of scope.

reviewer_assignment.rule: Reviewer authority is active tenant membership PLUS an explicit application assignment. An unassigned or out-of-tenant object returns an indistinguishable 404.

tenant_capability.rule: Scope BEFORE lookup via visible_institution_queryset: an out-of-scope (other-tenant) object is an indistinguishable 404. An in-scope object with a missing tenant.* capability is a non-revealing 403 that leaks no tenant id/name/count/attribute.

platform_capability.rule: Platform authority sees all tenants, so there is no cross-tenant masking; a missing platform.* capability is a non-revealing 403. A genuinely absent object id is a generic 404.

worker.rule: Internal worker/command surface — not an actor-facing HTTP endpoint.

internal_callback.rule: Inbound provider callback authenticated by signature/HMAC. Returns 200 on every processing outcome so internal state cannot be probed; an invalid signature is rejected without disclosure.

infra.rule: Infrastructure / documentation surface (health, OpenAPI schema, docs, API root, Django operational admin). Not part of the admissions authority matrix.

jobs_ops.rule: Separate AI job-hunting product (gated behind ENABLE_JOBS_OPS_ROUTES). Out of the admissions authority model; excluded from the five-actor admissions case matrix. Carries its own public-read / authenticated-write / policy-gated model.
